patterns.note: Sections alternate between a clean white background and a deep indigo/dark blue background, creating clear visual separation and hierarchy down the page.
Content is consistently centered within a maximum-width container, providing ample whitespace on the sides for readability and focus.
Headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif typeface for impact, contrasted with smaller, uppercase labels for sub-categories or feature titles.

A vibrant green (#31d891) is used as the primary accent color for calls-to-action, key highlights within diagrams, and progress indicators, providing a consistent visual cue for interactive elements and positive outcomes.
Complex, data-rich diagrams and illustrations are integrated directly into the hero and feature sections, serving as primary visual explanations of the product's functionality and benefits.

No scroll-triggered motion (such as element reveals, parallax, or sticky transformations) was observed from the provided homepage screenshot and subsequent images, which appear to be different pages rather than scroll depths of the homepage.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a prominent, large headline and subtext, accompanied by a complex, illustrative diagram that visually explains the product's value proposition. While the 'video-hero' hint suggests dynamic content, the provided images show a static visual.

Content sections are visually segmented by alternating full-width background colors (white and a deep indigo), with all textual and illustrative content contained within a central, fixed-width container to maintain a structured layout.

Primary calls-to-action are designed as solid, vibrant green rectangular buttons with white text, while secondary calls-to-action are outlined buttons with dark text, providing a clear visual hierarchy for user interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner radius on buttons, cards, and input fields, creating a soft but not rounded feel).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is particularly airy, while content sections maintain good vertical rhythm and separation between elements.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its heavy reliance on intricate, data-visualization-style diagrams and illustrations that are central to explaining the product. These visuals are not merely decorative but are integral to the content, effectively communicating complex concepts and value propositions without excessive text.
